decision_record.mechanism: No change. Candidate leaks examined and discharged with evidence (below): (1) a held name whose bars stop being served never exits sleeve-side — but every entry intent carries ExitRule time_bars=HOLD_BARS, which the dispatcher enforces independently of the sleeve's bar view, so the exit does not depend on the sleeve seeing bars; the sleeve-side staged exit (HOLD_BARS-1) is a second, earlier path, not the only one. (2) p90 computed over all delivered scores including names that later fail MIN_PX/dv20 — that population IS the sleeve's stated law ('top tenth of delivered scores', ENH1 decision record), not a leak. (3) Sizing uses the last served close — entries are market intents on daily bars re-evaluated every 300s; no stale-price sizing basis like a weekly qualifier close exists here.
decision_record.transfer: Top-decile GBM scores, 1% notional each, 21-session hold. ENH1 replaced the frozen absolute cut with the session's own p90 (the sleeve's stated top-tenth law).

verdict: VERIFY-ONLY — no second binding leak survives scrutiny
